description: Read the VAT payments HMRC has received on the company's account directly from HMRC MTD. Use when the user asks "has HMRC received my VAT payment", "what VAT have I paid". Requires HMRC MTD connected.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 12 months ago. A range longer than about a year is capped to the year ending at the end date, so ask in yearly chunks for anything older.

name: get_hmrc_vat_payments
title: Get Hmrc Vat Payments
